dedupe_keys.name: d4runoff parametric library of nature based solutions for urban drainage d3 1 and design spreadsheet

description: This D4RUNOFF deliverable proposes a library of 13 nature-based solutions for urban drainage, each with a file of criteria for decision making, and a simplified parametric design method identifying the main design parameters such as occupation area and water depth. An Excel spreadsheet for initial design is provided as an annex, with a chapter on how to use it and a proposed method for creating NBS drainage elements in Building Information Modelling (BIM); the report also reviews literature on how some NBS remove contaminants of emerging concern. The library builds on the NBS classification of the Green-Up project. It was written by Valerio Andrés Valeri and colleagues at the Universidad de Cantabria in the EU-funded D4RUNOFF project on hybrid nature-based solutions for diffuse urban runoff pollution, and published on Zenodo in September 2024: the report as a downloadable PDF and the supporting data as a RAR archive, both under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Caveats: the data record has no description of its contents, the authors ask users to contact them for updated versions of the design tool, and later deliverables add the multi-criteria and GIS siting steps. It supports sizing green-blue drainage measures in climate adaptation and stormwater capacity planning; a related record is the EPA National Stormwater Calculator.
name: D4RUNOFF parametric library of nature-based solutions for urban drainage (D3.1 and design spreadsheet)
